name: teamcraft
description: Working time and leave for a small Austrian team: time clock, AZG section 26 timesheets, Arbeitszeitgesetz checks, leave and balances, KV pay floor check, capacity for taskcraft. Not payroll.

tools.name: team_status
tools.description: Counts (active employees, clocked in, open leave requests, active AZG findings) and who is clocked in now.

tools.name: team_employee_add
tools.description: Add an employee.

tools.name: team_employee_list
tools.description: List employees.

tools.name: team_employee_update
tools.description: Change employee fields; null clears kv_name/kv_group/monthly_gross.

tools.name: team_clock_in
tools.description: Start a time entry (one open entry per employee).

tools.name: team_clock_out
tools.description: Close the open entry with break minutes.

tools.name: team_time_add
tools.description: Record a past entry.

tools.name: team_time_list
tools.description: Entries and daily totals in a date range.

tools.name: team_time_delete
tools.description: Delete an entry (refused in confirmed weeks).

tools.name: team_week_confirm
tools.description: Employee confirms an ISO week (2026-W45).

tools.name: team_azg_check
tools.description: Check working-time law (10h/12h daily, 60h weekly, 48h 17-week average, 30 min break above 6h, 11h rest).

tools.name: team_violations
tools.description: Recorded AZG findings; cleared ones only with include_cleared.

tools.name: team_leave_request
tools.description: Request leave.

tools.name: team_leave_decide
tools.description: Approve or reject a request.

tools.name: team_leave_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a requested or approved leave.

tools.name: team_leave_list
tools.description: Leaves, optionally by employee, year and status.

tools.name: team_leave_balance
tools.description: Vacation entitlement (pro rata in the start year), taken, pending, remaining; sick/comp/unpaid day counts.

tools.name: team_leave_adjust
tools.description: Add or subtract vacation days for a year (carry-over etc.), with a reason.

tools.name: team_holidays
tools.description: Austrian national public holidays of a year.

tools.name: team_kv_import
tools.description: Import KV minimum wages from CSV kv;group;valid_from;monthly_min;weekly_hours.

tools.name: team_kv_list
tools.description: KV minimum table.

tools.name: team_kv_check
tools.description: Compare each employee's gross with the KV minimum valid on a date, pro rata to weekly hours.

tools.name: team_timesheet
tools.description: Monthly working-time record (AZG section 26): per day start/end/break/worked/absence/holiday/AZG flags, worked vs target.

tools.name: team_capacity
tools.description: Available hours per employee for an ISO week after holidays and approved leave.

tools.name: team_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY database with a labelled demo team, fictional KV table and deliberate AZG findings.
